as_told.title: Mitchell hears of Roswell from residents and von Braun

plain: Roswell is a town in New Mexico where, in 1947, many people say a craft crashed and was taken away by the military. Edgar Mitchell was an Apollo astronaut, one of the men who went to the Moon. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that because of who he was, Mitchell heard all sorts of things about Roswell from people at every level. A guest named Maaneli Derakhshani puts it more directly: Mitchell said clearly that he believed an alien spacecraft had crashed at Roswell and the government had recovered it. If true, it would mean a respected astronaut had inside word of a recovered alien craft.
